symbols.title: Symbols / Tickers
symbols.description: List of tickers or symbols to analyze (e.g. SPY, QQQ, AAPL, NVDA, TSLA, BTC-USD, EURUSD=X, GC=F).

yearsBack.title: Years of Historical Data
yearsBack.description: Historical time horizon in years for drawdown analysis and risk calculation (e.g., 5, 10, 20).

startDate.title: Custom Start Date (Optional)
startDate.description: Optional explicit start date (YYYY-MM-DD). If provided, overrides yearsBack.

endDate.title: Custom End Date (Optional)
endDate.description: Optional explicit end date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to current date.

riskFreeRate.title: Annual Risk-Free Rate (%)
riskFreeRate.description: Benchmark risk-free rate percentage used for Sharpe and Sortino calculations (e.g. 4.0 for 4%).

rollingWindow.title: Rolling Window for Sharpe (Trading Days)
rollingWindow.description: Window size for rolling Sharpe ratio calculation (default 252 trading days / 1 year).

includeTimeSeries.title: Include Full Time-Series (Drawdowns & Rolling Sharpe)
includeTimeSeries.description: Include day-by-day drawdown series and rolling Sharpe time series arrays in the output.

includeReturnDistribution.title: Include Return Distribution (Histogram & Gaussian Fit)
includeReturnDistribution.description: Include 50-bin return frequency distribution, Gaussian PDF curve, and Value at Risk (VaR / CVaR).
